title: Region-aware analytics shards & legal-tagged replication
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Goal: Ensure console usage analytics can be stored and queried within customer-designated regions while preserving a global fallback for non-restricted metrics. We'll introduce region-aware shards, legal-tag propagation at ingestion, and a replication controller that enforces residency policies. Key components: (1) event-proxy (Console -> pipeline) will attach tenant.residency_tag and tenant.kms_region; (2) pipeline-transformer will validate tags, strip PII if policy forbids replication, and route messages to region-specific Kafka topics; (3) analytics-writer will write to per-region ClickHouse (or BigQuery) clusters using region-specific KMS keys; (4) replication-controller service will enforce policy and manage cross-region mirroring only for allowed metrics. We will add feature flags to gate rollouts and provide a compatibility shim to serve aggregated/global metrics for tenants who opt-out of regional storage. See design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Region+Analytics+Replication and initial ADR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/blob/main/docs/adr/004-region-analytics.md
acceptance_criteria: Console events for residency-enabled tenants include tenant.residency_tag and kms_region metadata at ingestion
Pipeline routes events into region-specific topics and writers using the residency_tag
Replication controller prevents cross-region writes for metrics labeled 'legal:DO_NOT_REPLICATE'
End-to-end tests show <5s median replication latency for permitted cross-region mirrors and <500ms ingestion latency to primary region
Migration plan exists and has runbook + smoke tests; feature flag allows quick rollback
Security review completed and KMS-per-region integration validated
